## The Andes, lakes and Buenos Aires

In Bariloche, the combination of the Andes, lakes and forests is particularly striking. Mountain slopes meet the water, and the road offers a constantly changing perspective, with islands, peninsulas, bays and peaks appearing one after another. This is the peaceful, nature-focused part of the trip, where the scenery itself makes the strongest impression.

Buenos Aires has a completely different feel. Old buildings stand beside modern neighbourhoods, broad avenues lead to historic squares, and the city's culture remains closely linked to tango. In the evening, the experience continues in San Telmo at the La Ventana show, featuring orchestras, dancers and singers, as well as dinner with Argentine dishes and wine.
